summary: A Watchman cookie file (.watchman-cookie-studio-92073-29) is tracked in git at the repo root; it is a transient tool file and should be removed from the index and ignored
[review:unlabeled] A capped flake after a merge stops the run on wait-ci failed (outside a repeat) with no collect-findings run, so no [flaky-capped] row explains the stop while CI on main is green
[review:unlabeled] Job names are cut to 60 chars, so long matrix job names sharing a prefix count as one job
[review:unlabeled] The 3-flake cap never resets: history is append-only and an old flaky:<job> row blocks a new issue after the old one is resolved (owner decision: reset or time window)
[review:low] flag() takes the next word as the value even when it is another flag
[review:low] A failed history write returns recorded:false, indistinguishable from a duplicate, so a flake is silently not counted
